First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social pace.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Femme Pedale Women's Ride group ride

A women's social ride that meets every Thursday evening near Baylor in Old East Dallas. Listed as social pace and beginner friendly. Details and changes are posted in the group's Facebook group.
